adjudication.rationale: In `GroupsController#members`, the diff now does `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and directly applies them to the query: `group.users...limit(limit).offset(offset)`. There is no clamping/validation, so a negative `offset` (e.g. `-1`) can be passed through to SQL `OFFSET -1`, which can raise an error and yield a 500 on this public endpoint. Additionally, `limit` is user-controlled and unbounded (can be set arbitrarily large), which can cause performance/DoS issues. This behavior is visible and grounded in the changed controller code.
